description: This source file defines a test class `testCustomCallbackProxy` that extends `CustomLogger`. It implements custom logging callbacks for various events in an asynchronous context, primarily for testing and verification purposes within the project. It also initializes a global instance `my_custom_logger` for usage in tests.
